mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE drops below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a potential overheating economy with loose monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which historically correlates with increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines by more than 1% QoQ.
